clue.text: Coverage for hospital patient, female European in disastrous debt

indicators.note: the female European pair sits inside the rearranged word, so 'in' signals insertion
something disastrous has gone badly wrong, so the word beside it is wrecked into a new order

parts.note: the four letters of debt, rearranged
the female pronoun
E is the standard abbreviation for European

explanation.surface: A female European patient, buried in debt, needs covering in her hospital bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coverage' sounds like insurance for a patient in debt, but it is literal: the cloth over a bed.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedsheet is the linen covering laid over a patient lying in a hospital bed.

clue.text: They are placed inside small oxygen-supplying equipment

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
oxygen tents enclose a patient's bed to supply extra oxygen

explanation.surface: A description of compact gear that supplies oxygen, fitted inside something.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is vague on purpose: stents are tubes inserted into blood vessels to hold them open.
explanation.definitionFit: Stents are small mesh tubes surgeons insert inside arteries, so they are things placed inside the body.

clue.text: Confuse it with deceit about eating behaviour

indicators.note: to confuse letters is to jumble them, so the words that follow are mixed up

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: An instruction to muddle someone by lying about their eating habits.
explanation.definitionFit: Dietetic is the adjective for matters of diet, so it describes anything concerning eating behaviour.

clue.text: Highlight possible cause or effect of illness

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to emphasise, as a verb

definitions.text: possible cause or effect of illness
definitions.meaning: second meaning: mental or physical strain, which can bring on sickness or result from it

explanation.surface: Pointing out that something may either trigger an illness or follow from it.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb the word means to emphasise; as a noun it names the strain that can provoke or accompany illness.

clue.text: Cases resulting from extra time in game

indicators.note: the added time is put inside the name of the board game, so 'in' signals insertion

parts.note: the board game
an extra unit of time; T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Lawsuits arising from a match that went into extra time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cases' suggests legal or medical cases, but here it means boxes. T goes between the E and S of CHESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Chests are large boxes for storing things, so they are cases in the container sense.

clue.text: Moved quickly into outfit valuing intelligence — they are full of brains

indicators.note: the word for moved quickly goes into the organisation's name, so 'into' signals insertion

parts.note: the Central Intelligence Agency, the US spy organisation
past tense of run

explanation.surface: Clever people dashed to join a firm that prizes brainpower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Intelligence' looks like cleverness but means spying, pointing to the American agency.
explanation.definitionFit: Crania is the plural of cranium, the skull, and skulls are what hold brains.

clue.text: Rest is arranged for important person in hospital

indicators.note: arranged means put into order, here a different order of the letters before it

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A rest break has been organised for a VIP on the ward.
explanation.walkthrough: In British hospitals a sister is a senior nurse in charge of a ward.
explanation.definitionFit: A ward sister is the senior nurse running a hospital ward, a figure of real authority there.

clue.text: Mistreated tear in part of eye

indicators.note: something mistreated has been handled roughly, so the letters that follow are knocked out of order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A badly handled tear in the eye, as an ophthalmologist might report.
explanation.definitionFit: The retina is the light-sensitive layer lining the back of the eye, one of its parts.

clue.text: Physicians supporting revolutionary movement as propagandists

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means sitting underneath, so one word follows the other in the grid

parts.note: a spin is a turning or rotating motion
a direct synonym

explanation.surface: Doctors backing a revolutionary political cause act as its propagandists.
explanation.definitionFit: Spin doctors are press officers who put a favourable slant on news, which is propaganda work.

clue.text: Medical assistant for consultant on many cases

definitions.text: Medical assistant for consultant on many cases

parts.words: Medical assistant for consultant on many cases
parts.note: surface reading: a junior helping a hospital consultant with lots of patients
setter's reading: a consulting detective, whose friend and helper was a doctor

explanation.walkthrough: Sherlock Holmes called himself a consulting detective; his companion on the cases was Dr Watson, a medical man.
explanation.definitionFit: Dr Watson, a physician, assisted Sherlock Holmes in investigating crimes throughout Conan Doyle's stories.

clue.text: Licences, including one for those not well treated

indicators.note: one word including another holds it within, so the second goes inside the first

parts.note: patents are licences granting exclusive rights to an invention
the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Permits, one of them allowing poor treatment of people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not well treated' reads as mistreated, but splits as those who are not well, being treated. I goes between the A and T of PATENTS.
explanation.definitionFit: Patients are sick people receiving medical care, so they are unwell and under treatment.

clue.text: Issue returning for renowned healer

indicators.note: returning means going back the way it came, so the word is read from end to start

parts.note: to issue is to send out

explanation.surface: A recurring problem that calls for a famous healer.
explanation.walkthrough: The proverb says time is the great healer.
explanation.definitionFit: The saying that time heals all wounds makes the passage of time a famous healer of grief.

clue.text: Hygienic practice featured in campaign — is it, in a sense, backward-looking?

indicators.note: looking backward means facing the other way, so the run of letters is read right to left
something featured in a passage appears within it, so the letters lie inside the words that follow

parts.words: campaign — is it, in a sense
parts.note: the end of campaign, all of is it in a, and the start of sense

explanation.surface: Asking whether a campaign promoting hygiene is in some way regressive.
explanation.definitionFit: Sanitising means making clean and free of germs, which is a hygienic practice.

clue.text: Led by good type with characteristic spirit, manage diagnostic device

indicators.note: being led by something means coming after it, so the final word follows the earlier pieces

parts.note: a saint, a good person, abbreviated ST
the distinctive spirit of a group or era
to cope is to manage

explanation.surface: Guided by a principled person of distinctive character, one can manage a diagnostic tool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Led by' puts the final word after everything before it; a saint is the crossword's usual good type.
explanation.definitionFit: A stethoscope lets a doctor listen to heart and lungs, a basic instrument for diagnosis.

clue.text: Where casualties may be treated in areas of warfare

definitions.meaning: first meaning: operating ... in a hospital
second meaning: ... of war, regions where fighting takes place

explanation.surface: Wounded soldiers being treated in combat zones.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgery happens in operating theatres, and a region of military operations is called a theatre of war.

clue.text: Criticize confused medic in major health crisis

indicators.note: confused means mixed up, so the letters of the next word are muddled

parts.note: to pan is to criticise harshly, as a reviewer does
the letters of medic rearranged

explanation.surface: Blaming a bewildered doctor during a serious public health emergency.
explanation.definitionFit: A pandemic is a disease outbreak spreading across countries or continents, a health emergency on a large scale.

clue.text: Kind of medication from doctor initially in control

indicators.note: the selected letter is placed in the word for control, so 'in' signals insertion

parts.note: power is control or authority

indicators.note: initially points to the start, so only the opening letter of the word is used

parts.note: the first letter of doctor

explanation.surface: A type of drug supplied by a doctor who is in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: D goes between the W and E of POWER.
explanation.definitionFit: Many medicines come as a powder to be dissolved or taken in a measured dose, one form of medication.

clue.text: Where blood flows to one's ears ineffectually

indicators.note: what reaches the ears is what is heard, so the phrase is to be taken by sound

parts.note: blood flows in a vein, and the phrase sounds identical to one meaning uselessly

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about where blood goes, said to sound useless.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in vain means doing it to no effect, so the phrase means ineffectually.

clue.text: Improved in health without your old-fashioned healer

indicators.note: without here is the old sense of outside, so one word wraps around the other

parts.note: feeling better means recovered
one's is the formal impersonal form of your, as in 'one's own'

explanation.surface: Recovered without the help of your traditional healer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Without' looks like 'lacking' but is the old sense of outside, so one word wraps the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonesetter was a traditional, unqualified practitioner who reset broken or dislocated bones.

clue.text: Tax cut in surgical fashion

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a duty levied on goods produced at home
second meaning: to remove by cutting out, as a surgeon does

explanation.surface: A tax reduction performed with surgical precision.
explanation.definitionFit: Excise is a duty on home-produced goods, and to excise tissue is to remove it surgically.

clue.text: Feel poorly when caught by right cross, something doctor may check

indicators.note: something caught by others is held between them, so it goes inside
poorly means unwell or in bad shape, so the letters of the word before it are disordered

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right
the letters of feel rearranged
a cross is the shape X

explanation.surface: Feeling ill after being hit by a right cross, the boxing punch, so the doctor checks reflexes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right cross' looks like a boxing punch but is two pieces: R and X around the rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Doctors test reflexes, such as tapping the knee, as a routine check on the nervous system.

clue.text: Evil doctor repeated unacceptable act

indicators.note: repeated means said twice, so the same piece is written down a second time alongside itself

parts.note: Dr No, the villain of the James Bond novel and film
the villain's name again

explanation.surface: A wicked doctor commits the same unforgivable act again.
explanation.definitionFit: A no-no is something not done or not permitted, a forbidden or unacceptable act.

clue.text: Teacher's disorder cured at hydro, finally

indicators.note: disorder means lack of order, so the letters that follow are scrambled

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: finally points to the end, so only the closing letter of the word is used

parts.note: the last letter of hydro

explanation.surface: A teacher's ailment was finally cured at a hydro, a spa hotel offering water treatments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Teacher's' is Teacher is; 'disorder' looks like an illness but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An educator is someone who teaches, a direct synonym for teacher.

clue.text: Like first position reversed, bit by bit, of late

indicators.note: reversed bit by bit means each word is turned round separately, while they keep their order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Something that has recently been turned back to its first position, piece by piece.
explanation.walkthrough: Reversing the whole of 'of late' gives ETALFO; each word must be turned separately.
explanation.definitionFit: The foetal position, curled up, is the first posture anyone has, adopted in the womb.

clue.text: Continued without changing what someone in theatre did that's not working

definitions.text: what someone in theatre did that's not working
definitions.meaning: second meaning: an actor between jobs is said to be resting

explanation.surface: An unemployed actor carried on the same as ever.
explanation.definitionFit: To rest is to stay as is, and actors out of work describe themselves, euphemistically, as resting.

clue.text: Not a threat to health, good in part of Africa

indicators.note: the letter for good is set in the country's name, so 'in' signals insertion

parts.note: Benin is a West African country
G is the abbreviation for good

explanation.surface: A healthy region somewhere in Africa that poses no danger.
explanation.walkthrough: G goes between BENI and N.
explanation.definitionFit: A benign tumour is harmless and not cancerous, so the word describes what poses no health threat.
